details:
Say in our World Tab section.......VRChat cant seem to stop giving us more Categories like 

"Here you go .... have more New Categories :3 more Redundant Categories :3 more Repetitive Categories <3 so your Favorite and Work Categories are so Far down Categories that UnityChan Satan goes Bonkers saying 'WTF your invading my space' Category. "

Seriously CUT back on this Crap.......You Load in a Crack ton of Worlds with their Thumbnails and SOME of these have Names on the Thumbnails too but many don't.

So why not make a List funtion that only displays names.
A Text list only worlds or social tab. No Imgs No Thumbnails
using social tab as example....
.
.
 Horizontal method
{Favorite Slots}                                             
[ (A Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (B Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (C Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
[ (D Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (E Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (F Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
{Friends}                                             
[ (A Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (B Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (C Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
[ (D Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (E Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (F Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
.
 Vertical method
{Favorite Slots}                                   {Friends}         
[ (A Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (A Username)(worldname)(Status) ] 
[ (B Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (B Username)(worldname)(Status) ] 
[ (C Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (C Username)(worldname)(Status) ] 
[ (D Username)(worldname)(Status) ] [ (D Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
.
.
.
Example 1
[ (A Username)(worldname)(Status) ]
.
.
Example 2
[ (A Username)   (Status) ]
[         (worldname)          ]
.
.
.
title: Give us List Option on World and Social Tab = Less Loading Lag
